about_the_game:
Within the world of Trader's Trail Tales, players traverse forests, deserts, snowy lands, oceans, and villages, experiencing the adventurous life of a merchant.

  • Dynamic Economy & Trade System:
    The game features 10 categories of goods (crops, minerals, spices, etc.) with prices that fluctuate in real-time based on location and supply/demand. Players must diligently record prices to maximize profits by trading strategically across different regions.

  • Adventure Meets Combat:
    Maps conceal caves and perilous zones where players must solve puzzles involving mechanisms like stone walls and minecart arrays to obtain rare treasures. Along the journey, they will battle diverse types of monsters, navigating through hazards to ensure their safety and discover new towns and villages.

  • Narrative & Character Growth:
    Through travel, players encounter a wide array of people and events. By aiding others, they achieve personal growth, accumulate renown, and ultimately face a special trial to become a distinguished entrepreneur.

💡 Featuring classic map structures and nostalgic story easter eggs, it offers pixel art enthusiasts a double dose of classic reminiscence.

short_description: Trader's Trail Tales blends classic ARPG and business strategy in a pixel-art adventure. As a traveling merchant, you journey across city-states: buy low/sell high for profit, explore ruins to solve puzzles, and fight bandits/monsters. Grow from peddler to tycoon. With vibrant 16-bit pixel art
